# SHARED CONTRACT — 600 Essential Words for the TOEIC (Local Web App)

Read this before writing code. It is the single source of truth for interfaces.
**Do not edit files outside your task's declared write scope.**

## Repo layout

```
TiengAnh/
├─ app/                        # Vite + React 19 + Tailwind v4 app  (npm run dev / build)
│  ├─ vite.config.js           # publicDir -> ../public  (Lead-owned)
│  ├─ src/
│  │  ├─ App.jsx               # shell: sidebar + header + 5 tabs (Lead-owned)
│  │  ├─ index.css             # Tailwind + .flip-* / .vocab-hit / .cloze-blank (Lead-owned)
│  │  ├─ data/curriculum.js    # THEMES, LESSON_TITLES, themeForLesson()  (Lead-owned)
│  │  ├─ lib/
│  │  │  ├─ types.js           # Lesson/WordEntry typedefs + LESSON_STATUS  (Lead-owned)
│  │  │  ├─ assets.js          # URL builders + highlight + cloze helpers   (Lead-owned)
│  │  │  ├─ lessonLoader.js    # dynamic lesson loading + 50-lesson index   (Lead-owned)
│  │  │  ├─ storage.js         # LocalStorage settings/progress/SRS/history (Lead-owned)
│  │  │  ├─ srs.js             # SM-2 scheduler + GRADE buttons             (Lead-owned)
│  │  │  └─ store.jsx          # AppProvider + useApp()                     (Lead-owned)
│  │  ├─ components/ui.jsx     # Button/Card/Badge/Highlighted/useSpeech…   (Lead-owned)
│  │  └─ tabs/Tab1..Tab5.jsx   # ONE OWNER PER FILE (teammates)
├─ public/                     # generated by scripts/normalize_assets.py (Lead-owned)
│  ├─ audio/track_01..50.mp3   # all 50 playable MP3 (tracks 1-25 were WMA, converted)
│  ├─ part1_photos/lesson_01..50.jpg
│  ├─ lessons_json/lesson_NN.json    # OCR output lands here  <-- primary load path
│  └─ sample_lessons/lesson_01.json  # bundled sample fallback
└─ scripts/                    # OCR + asset scripts (Lead-owned)
```

## Data shape (mirrors sample_lessons/lesson_01.json exactly)

```jsonc
{
  "lesson_id": 1, "title": "Contracts", "theme_id": 1, "theme_name": "General Business",
  "audio_track": "audio/track_01.mp3", "part1_photo": "part1_photos/lesson_01.jpg",
  "words_to_learn": [{
    "id": 1, "word": "abide by", "pos": "v.", "ipa": "/əˈbaɪd baɪ/",
    "definition_en": "to comply with; to conform",
    "definition_vi": "tuân thủ, làm theo…",
    "collocations": ["abide by a decision", "…"],
    "examples": [{ "en": "The two parties agreed to abide by the judge's decision.", "vi": "…" }],
    "word_family": [{ "pos": "verb", "word": "abide", "example": "…" }]   // may be absent
  }],
  "words_in_context": { "word_bank": [12 strings], "passage": "… (1) ___ …", "answers": { "1": "agreement", … } },
  "practice": {
    "listening": {
      "part1": { "question_num": 1, "photo": "part1_photos/lesson_01.jpg" },
      "part2": [{ "question_num": 2, "options": ["A","B","C"] }],
      "part3": [{ "question_num": 4, "question": "…", "options": { "A": "…", … } }],
      "part4": [{ "question_num": 7, "question": "…", "options": {…} }]
    },
    "reading": {
      "part5": [{ "question_num": 10, "sentence": "… ___ …", "options": {…}, "answer": "A" }],
      "part6": { "title": "…", "passage": "… [16] … [17] … [18] …", "questions": [{ question_num, options, answer }] },
      "part7": { "passages": [{ "type": "letter|form|memo|email", "header": "…", "body": "…" }],
                 "questions": [{ "question_num": 19, "question": "…", "options": {…}, "answer": "A" }] }
    }
  }
}
```

`lessonLoader.normalizeLesson()` fills every optional branch, so after loading you can
always assume: `lesson.words_to_learn`, `lesson.words_in_context`,
`lesson.practice.listening.{part1,part2,part3,part4}`,
`lesson.practice.reading.{part5,part6,part7}` all exist (possibly empty/null).

## Frozen APIs — import these, never re-implement

```js
// ../lib/types.js
LESSON_STATUS, NOT_EXTRACTED_LABEL, WORD_FAMILY_ORDER, WORD_FAMILY_LABEL

// ../lib/assets.js
audioUrlFor(lessonId) -> "/audio/track_01.mp3"
photoUrlFor(lessonId) -> "/part1_photos/lesson_01.jpg"
highlightWord(text, words) -> [{text, hit}]      // low-level
makeCloze(sentence, word, token='______') -> string
buildWordRegex(words) -> RegExp|null
collectSentences(lesson) -> [{word,pos,en,vi,source}]

// ../lib/store.jsx
useApp() -> { lessonId, setLessonId, tab, setTab, lessonState, lesson,
              lessonIndex, refreshIndex, progress, setProgress, srs, setSrs,
              settings, updateSettings }

// ../components/ui.jsx
Button, Card, Badge, Highlighted({text, words}), SectionTitle,
Spinner, EmptyState, ProgressBar, TabBar, useSpeech()->{speak,supported}, useToast()

// ../lib/srs.js
GRADES = {1:'Again',2:'Hard',3:'Good',4:'Easy'}   // quality 1..5
recordReview(lessonId, word, grade) -> card
cardsForLesson(lessonId) -> [{key, ease, interval, reps, due, …}]
buildQueue(lessonId, words) -> [{word, card}]
isDue(card, now?)

// ../lib/storage.js
loadSettings/saveSettings, loadProgress/saveProgress, markWordLearned(lessonId, word),
loadSrs/saveSrs, loadHistory/pushHistory, srsKey(lessonId, word), clearAll()
```

## Hard rules

1. **Context-First.** A target word is NEVER rendered alone. It always ships with its
   in-book example sentence, its collocations, and its word-family table. Inside any
   sentence use `<Highlighted text={sentence} words={allLessonWords} />` — never
   hand-rolled regex.
2. **Null-safe.** `App.jsx` passes `lesson={null}` when a lesson is missing. Every tab
   must render a friendly Vietnamese empty state instead of crashing.
3. **Imports.** Only from the modules listed above plus `lucide-react`. Do not create new
   shared lib files; put helpers inside your own tab file.
4. **Language.** UI copy in Vietnamese; vocabulary/passage content stays English.
5. **Styling.** Tailwind v4. Brand tokens `brand-50..900` exist. Reuse `.flip-scene`,
   `.flip-inner`, `.flip-face`, `.vocab-hit`, `.cloze-blank` from `index.css`.
6. **npm.** Always set a workspace cache before npm commands, otherwise npm fails with a
   log-write error:
   `$env:npm_config_cache="D:\LEGION\Documents\deepseek-harness\TiengAnh\.npm-cache"`
